notes.title: Update Notes For July 24th
notes.content:
I did some small fixes!

[list]
[*] The game now saves after a completed challenge. Hopefully this solves an issue where all progress was lost on a restart of the game.
[*] Tweaked the "Are We There Yet?" achievement to make it less grindy.
[/list]

notes.title: Autogame Deluxe is releasing July 21st!
notes.content: [h3][b]Autogame Deluxe[/b] will release on [b]July 21st![/b][/h3][p]To celebrate the upcoming release, Autogame will be taking part in this week's Steam Next Fest![/p][p][/p][p]The full game will include:[/p][list][*][p]Local multiplayer with up to 10 players[/p][/*][*][p]Support for any keyboard or controller you can think of, including sharing a controller[/p][/*][*][p]Bots to fill up any empty driver seat (optional)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustable settings for more replayability and chaos![/p][/*][*][p]20 single player challenges with weird twists (drive 88 mph, in the dark, or... eat cars?)[/p][/*][*][p]Some unlockable twists that can be added to your multiplayer games![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I'm also happy to share that the game will be available in 10 languages:[/p][list][*][p]English[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]Italian[/p][/*][*][p]Portugese (Brazilian)[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Arabic[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Wishlist, go play the demo, and let me know what you think on the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1952450/discussions/1/"]Steam forum[/url] or [url="https://discord.gg/mkCUve4at2"]Discord[/url]![/h3][p]As always: the game (and demo!) is best local multiplayer but do [b]try it with your online friends as well using Remote Play Together[/b]! You still only need one copy to play![/p]

notes.title: Autogame Deluxe Demo
notes.content:
The demo for Autogame Deluxe is live! Get a taste of the chaos with 1-4 players or try out the first 5 special single player challenges! Not in one room together? No problem, try Steam Remote Play Together!

The demo features:
[list]
[*] Up to 4 players. The full game will allow for 10 simultaneous players
[*] Play with keyboard, as well as gamepads
[*] The single screen gameplay is ideal for Steam's Remote Play Together
[*] 5 single player challenges with special rules. The full game will have 20 for you!
[/list]
